preconditions.description: The number of balls in the first player's box must be between 1 and 50.
The number of balls in the second player's box must be between 1 and 50.
The maximum number of balls the first player can take in one move must be between 1 and 50.
The maximum number of balls the second player can take in one move must be between 1 and 50.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'First' if n_1 > n_2 else stdout == 'Second'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'First' if the first player wins, otherwise 'Second'.
